shortDescription: An earthquake measuring 5.2 magnitude struck the Hindu Kush region in Afghanistan on Sunday, the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre said.EMSC earlier estimated the earthquake at magnitude 5.8, before downgrading it to 5.2.The quake was at a depth of 110 km (68.35 miles), the centre added.

children: An earthquake measuring 5.2 magnitude struck the Hindu Kush region in Afghanistan on Sunday, the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre said.
EMSC earlier estimated the earthquake at magnitude 5.8, before downgrading it to 5.2.
The quake was at a depth of 110 km (68.35 miles), the centre added.
